run_big_batch_search: run big_batch_search on an IVF index with queries xq and k nearest neighbors
run_big_batch_search_threaded: run big_batch_search with threaded mode 2 using prefetch and computation threads for GPU
run_big_batch_search_checkpoint: run big_batch_search with checkpointing to resume interrupted large scale searches
create_BigBatchSearcher: create a BigBatchSearcher instance to manage coarse quantization and result heap for batch search
create_BlockComputer: create a BlockComputer for IVF index to perform blockwise KNN or pairwise distance search
